review_scope: Bounded source/assertion review. Parent findings and gate-results supersede draft/run status. Neither whole-clause nor all-feature certification.

selected_reviews.title: The forms rows' claims, read against their lines, and the latest statement about a value stands
selected_reviews.review: Retain the fixed ordering of user edit, import, reset and stored /V: current set/import/reset code explicitly forgets displaced statements, and value_statements.rs covers ordering in both directions. Narrow the save claim to the shapes actually tested. Existing tests use a merged one-widget field whose /DV is local; they do not prove that a save preserves distinct per-terminal reset defaults when /V is inherited from a common ancestor. The new two-terminal fixture directly tests that case. This is a point-level review, not an ADR-wide rejection.

selected_reviews.title: The field hierarchy is followed without a depth bound
selected_reviews.review: Retain the interpretation that §12.7.4.1 forbids a fixed inheritance-depth limit; direct 4,000-link and public deeper-chain tests support the read path. A successful unlimited read does not prove write placement is correct when a shared ancestor's inherited /V must become two distinct terminal values. The holder helper's choice of the existing /V ancestor needs a sibling-conflict test. This says nothing against the cycle handling or overall lineage cache.

selected_reviews.title: A text value is held to /MaxLen in the model, and /Enforce is a restriction at the reader's level
selected_reviews.review: Retain /MaxLen cutting as the explicit owner decision in A834 item 1; distinguish that ratified product behavior from the limited literal wording of Table 232. New max_len_model tests assert resulting text and saved values, but not generated page text after truncation. The inherited reset finding is separate and does not depend on the MaxLen policy.

selected_reviews.title: A form's limits and commits hold in every control, and an FDF file's options, pages and scripts are applied
selected_reviews.review: For this shard, rely on ADR 2840 as the later owner-backed decision for model-level /MaxLen behavior. No conclusion is drawn here about GTK/Qt limits, selection commit timing, FDF scripts/options, or any other ADR 2816 section.
